records.text: Candace Owens is Christian first and will not support killing people to pursue an end that has not been articulated.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And that means that I will not support murdering people incessantly to fulfill some end that hasn't even been articulated to us. It's just like the greater Israel project, like they have to just keep killing people and nobody really knows why.

records.text: Israel wants the United States to fight its war so it can expand its borders and become a global superpower.
records.speaker: Tucker Carlson

appearances.snippet: They know the U.S. fighting their war for them is the best chance at expanding their borders and becoming a global superpower, and a peace deal would foil their plot.

verification.notes: Transcript context confirms this was Tucker Carlson quoted by Owens. AP reporting confirms a joint U.S.-Israeli campaign against Iran and documents major Israeli territorial expansion and buffer-zone seizures since 2023. Those facts support parts of the description, but no conclusive evidence establishes the specific causal motive that Israel sought U.S. combat so it could expand borders and become a global superpower.
